name: ACI Worldwide
outlook:
What ACI Worldwide says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue and adjusted EBITDAThe company expects revenue in the range of $1.895 billion to $1.925 billion and adjusted EBITDA in the range of $550 million to $565 million, which is up from the range of $545 million to $560 million.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenue and adjusted EBITDAThe company expects Q4 2026 revenue of $612 million to $642 million and adjusted EBITDA of $257 million to $272 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
